opportunities.point: The company plans to increase its capital expenditure for FY27 to about INR1,500 crores, following an expenditure of INR740 crores in FY26.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "We plan to increase our capex for FY27 to about INR1,500 crores in addition to the FY26 capex that we have incurred of INR740 crores." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The planned capex breakup for FY27 includes around INR400 crores from the conductor division, around INR200-odd crores from the oil division, and approximately INR850 crores from the cable division.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Around INR400 crores would be coming from conductor division, around INR200-odd crores on oil division, and cable would be in the range of INR850 crores." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: A capex build-up is underway, pointing to future capacity.
opportunities.evidence: CWIP 130 Cr -> 540 Cr (315%) as of Mar 2026

opportunities.point: The price embeds less growth than the company has actually delivered.
opportunities.evidence: Reverse DCF implies 24.2% earnings growth vs 44% delivered over 5 years

opportunities.point: Rising institutional interest can keep supporting the price.

opportunities.point: A capital goods tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
New order inflow from the US has started to increase in the cable division.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "New order inflow from US has started to increase." (concall ppt - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: Management stated that the structural energy infrastructure fundamentals remain robust, supported by growth in T&D, rising electricity demand, and increasing evacuation infrastructure.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "However, having said that, structurally, energy infrastructure fundamentals remain intact with the growth in T&D, rising electricity demand and evacuation infrastructure being increased, data center expansion, the growing presence of EVs, more opportunities..." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

opportunities.point: The conductor division's pending order book stands at around INR10,190 crores with an export proportion of 56.8%.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "The pending order book stands at around INR10,190 crores with an export proportion of 56.8%." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: New orders received by the conductor division were INR5,245 crores in the quarter, with exports contributing 65.8%.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "New orders received by the conductor division were INR5,245 crores in the quarter, of which exports contributed to 65.8%." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: Large orders exceeding ₹ 2,800 crores from two major overseas electric utility companies have a delivery period spread over the next 4 years.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "This includes large orders exceeding ₹ 2,800 crores from two major overseas electric utility companies with a delivery period spread over next 4 years reinforcing the investments behind transmission capex globally" (concall ppt - 2026-07-01) [next 2 years]

opportunities.point: Management stated that from a medium to long-term perspective, conductor margins are expected to be in the range of INR35,000 to INR36,000 per metric ton plus tailwinds.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "And based on the historical EBITDA margin that we have made, we expect that from a medium to long-term perspective, our conductor margins could be in the range of INR35,000 to INR36,000 per metric ton." (concall transcript - 2026-06-01)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.

threats.point: A premium multiple versus peers can unwind quickly if growth slips.
Promoter selling is a warning about insider conviction.

threats.evidence: Price grew 94% vs profit 44% (5Y) — stock ahead of fundamentals; watch valuation.

threats.point: The quarter was challenging due to the impact of the U.S.-Iran war, logistics difficulties in export markets, and manpower shortages in May.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Otherwise, this has been a fairly challenging quarter from an external perspective, given the impact of the U.S.-Iran war, various logistics difficulties that have happened in the export markets and fairly significant manpower-related shortages in the month..." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

threats.point: Conductor volumes were down 6.7% due to a surge in metal prices impacting delivery schedules where customers withheld manufacturing clearance.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Volume for the quarter was down 6.7% compared to a year ago. This can be attributed fundamentally to a surge in the metal prices that have impacted delivery schedules of orders which are in hand, where customers have withheld manufacturing clearance..." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

threats.point: Oil division volumes were affected because the UAE facility was restricted to making local deliveries due to the crisis and resulting closure of the Hamriyah port.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Volume for the quarter stands at 129,085 kL, down 13.7% compared to a year ago and down -- yes, the volumes were affected really because of our facility in the UAE, which because of this crisis and the resulting closure of the Hamriyah port was restricted to..." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Sep, Dec) are still in the cycle.
